reviewUpdated: **Updated:** 17 November 2026 — Run 06 native configuration/header repairs and expanded fidelity verification. Original findings and earlier snapshots remain historical; [the delivery ledger](DELIVERY_PLAN.md#complete-scope-and-resolution-ledger) owns current status.
planCurrentState: **Current state:** Run 06 repairs the iPad small-window header overlap and preserves Android route/input/quiz state through live font-size changes. **P05 remains active**: ordinary Android text retains stale sizing and quiz feedback clips, the historical Android digit-3 guide and newly measured maximum-size iOS J fail the strict raster envelope, and specific native coverage remains unrun. P05.6/.7 retain their verified delivery; P05.2/.8 remain partial. Expanded iOS maximum-text alphabet/converter/quiz coverage is now captured and measured, with its failures retained. Shared checks pass 80 tests, types/lint, the Expo-free scan and scoped production-web regression. P00–P04 retain agent-done status; P07.2's tested pure model still needs screen/audio integration; P06/P07.4/P08–P10 and M11 remain unfinished. [Run 06 evidence](evidence/run06/README.md), [source identity](evidence/run06/source-identity.json). This is not release approval.
